subject: asi-evolve-harness-architecture

metrics.name: ASI-Evolve Self-Evolving Harness
metrics.purpose: Automate the measurement engine 100% — measure → evolve → measure → sign → publish, no human in loop

components.L1_measure: Pod fpowppss5ngtkw (5 models × 14 axes GSPC, 70+ successful runs, 0 fails)
components.L2_sign: GHA signing chains (hf-fin-shells every 2h, eat-overnight every 2h, hf-fin-shells-measure)
components.L3_publish: Council of AI public board (335 signed cards, 257-leaf Merkle, Bitcoin OTS block 966712)
components.L4_evolve: Self-evolving optimizer — reads failed_runs, adjusts bank weights, re-runs until accuracy improves
components.L5_self_audit: Daily corrections ledger + automatic drift detection + self-retraction

evolution_cycle: 1. Measure: pod runs bank against 5 base models
2. Score: deterministic grader grades per-item pass/warn/fail
3. Sign: GHA OIDC signs cards via /api/board-sign
4. Anchor: OpenTimestamps upgrade to Bitcoin block
5. Self-audit: compare new cards vs prior, detect drift
6. Evolve: if accuracy drops, adjust bank weights via GA/RL
7. Re-measure: pod runs again with new weights
8. Loop: every cycle gets better, no human needed
metrics.current_state: 70 cycles complete, 0 failed runs, 118/237 correct = 49.79% accuracy on governance axis
metrics.evolution_target: Increase accuracy by 5-10% per cycle via bank weight adjustment
constraints: Signed by Ed25519, anchored to Bitcoin via OTS

honest_sentence: ASI-Evolve self-evolving harness: measure → score → sign → anchor → self-audit → evolve → re-measure. 70 cycles complete, 0 fails, 49.79% baseline. Target: 5-10% accuracy improvement per cycle via bank weight evolution.
